details.description: Santoor has evolved from a traditional South Indian soap to a modern beauty soap that contains the secret to younger-looking skin for women of different age groups. Sandal and Turmeric have been essential parts of the Indian woman's skincare regimen for centuries. The deeply acting ingredients of Turmeric and Sandal in the soap provide smooth, soft, and clear skin while also giving a youthful glow to the skin. It has a fresh, energizing, and long-lasting fragrance. It is a great solution for problems such as blackheads, acne, and skin allergies. It removes tanning, cures skin itching, and detoxifies the skin.

details.description: Santoor is the flagship brand of Wipro Consumer Care. For over three decades, millions of Indian women have trusted Santoor, making it the No. 2 soap brand in the country. details.usageInstructions:
1. Wet your face with lukewarm water.
2. Rub the soap directly onto your clean hands, and then use your hands to apply the soap to your face.
3. Massage the soap into your skin for a maximum of 30 seconds, using small circular motions.

details.description: Enjoy bathing in the pure fragrance of sandalwood. The only soap has real sandalwood. It helps to deeply cleanse your skin and give it a radiant glow. Now stay fragrant all day long with Santoor Royal Sandal and make every day special.

Step 2: Apply Santoor Royal Sandal Soap and work it into a rich lather.

Step 5: Rinse thoroughly with water.
